## Purpose

Request execution cancellation; workspace pins remain until cleanup is verified.

The command delegates to `JobCommandsMixin` in
[`src/commands/job_commands.py`](../../../src/commands/job_commands.py).
Job state survives daemon restart in PostgreSQL; artifacts live under
`<data_dir>/runs/<job_id>/`. Scope checks deny other tasks and projects.

See the [durable wait guide](../../guides/agent-waits.md) for submission,
replay, deadlines, result consumption and installed grants.
